basis: Each photograph is the hotel's own or a Creative Commons image, collected from the page named on that property's own page here, with its credit and licence. Rights for onward publication are not cleared: this is a private portal and the photographs are here to identify the property, not to be republished.

adare-manor.note: Aerial view of the manor house, formal gardens and golf course; no people visible.

aman-rosa-alpina.licence: hotel website, rights not cleared for republication
aman-rosa-alpina.note: Exterior of the reopened (Jul 2025) resort against the Dolomites; no photographer named on the page.

amanzoe.licence: hotel group's own press/gallery imagery, rights not cleared for republication
amanzoe.note: Exterior architectural view of the colonnade, reflecting pool and Ed Tuttle's classical-Greek-inspired pavilions at dusk; unmistakably Amanzoe's signature architecture.

ballyfin-demesne.note: Front elevation of the neoclassical mansion from the drive, in its parkland setting. Clean CC licence.

beaverbrook.credit: Beaverbrook (hotel's own website imagery, used as the site's own og:image / homepage hero)
beaverbrook.licence: hotel's own press imagery, rights not cleared for republication
beaverbrook.note: Aerial drone shot of the main house and formal gardens; this is the hotel's own chosen social-share image, so it reads as their preferred representative photo. No usable image found on Wikimedia Commons for Beaverbrook.

belmond-caruso.licence: hotel group's own press imagery, rights not cleared for republication
belmond-caruso.note: Aerial/grounds view of the hotel's famous cliff-edge infinity pool with the wisteria pergola, terraces and Ravello/Amalfi coastline below -- no usable Wikimedia Commons image exists for this property; this is the hero image used on Belmond's own hotel page and is the standard published view of Caruso. One distant swimmer visible in the pool, not a portrait shot.

belmond-castello-di-casole.licence: hotel group's own press imagery (Belmond Mediahub), rights not cleared for republication
belmond-castello-di-casole.note: Dusk view of the castle's internal courtyard with the medieval tower visible; small figures are incidental, not portraits. No Wikimedia Commons coverage of Castello di Casole was found.

belmond-hotel-cipriani.note: View of the hotel facade and waterside terrace from the lagoon, with the HOTEL CIPRIANI signage visible. Clean CC licence.

belmond-hotel-splendido.note: Drone aerial of the hotel building on the hillside above Portofino, Sept 2023.

belmond-villa-san-michele.note: Front facade of the former Franciscan monastery, the loggia and pediment attributed to Michelozzo, taken at golden hour. A few parked cars and two guests are visible at the entrance but the building is the clear subject.

borgo-egnazia.licence: hotel website imagery, rights not cleared for republication
borgo-egnazia.source: https://www.borgoegnazia.com/en/ (retrieved via Wayback Machine snapshot dated 2024-11-25, since the live site returns HTTP 403 to automated fetches)
borgo-egnazia.note: The resort's distinctive limestone rooftop architecture (trulli-style chimneys/pinnacles) with the Adriatic Sea behind. Source file is only 1200x600 (the site's own og:image), so it is used at its native width with no upscaling. No Wikimedia Commons coverage found; the live borgoegnazia.com blocks non-browser HTTP clients (Cloudflare), so the image was recovered from a Wayback Machine cache of the same og:image the live site serves.

castello-di-reschio.note: Photographed December 2008, before the estate's restoration into the current hotel (which opened in the 2020s) — shows the castle's structure and setting on the hill, unrestored. Only Commons image of the building; no clean-licence post-restoration exterior found.

castiglion-del-bosco.credit: Rosewood Hotel Group (hotel's own press/website imagery)
castiglion-del-bosco.licence: hotel website, rights not cleared for republication
castiglion-del-bosco.note: Aerial of Il Borgo (the main hotel building) and pool set in the Tuscan estate; matches the page's own og:image subject ('Il Borgo with pool'). No photographer credited.

chateau-de-la-messardiere.licence: hotel's own press imagery, rights not cleared for republication
chateau-de-la-messardiere.note: Frontal exterior view of the château's turreted facade and formal garden approach at sunset. The only Wikimedia Commons image found (File:Château de la Messardière.png, CC BY-SA 4.0) is portrait-orientation and too small to use, so the hotel's own site was used instead.

cliveden-house.note: Exterior view of the Grade I Charles Barry mansion and its grounds, via Geograph.

coworth-park.licence: hotel group's own website imagery, rights not cleared for republication
coworth-park.note: Twilight/winter exterior of the main Georgian mansion house, lit up, no people. The only Wikimedia Commons Coworth Park exterior image found (geograph 6385472, 'Building in Coworth Park') was rejected: its own caption says it 'might be the estate offices' near the north gate, i.e. not confidently the main house, so it fails the 'unmistakably that hotel' bar.

danesfield-house.credit: Danesfield House Hotel & Spa (hotel's own website, homepage banner image)
danesfield-house.note: The hotel's own homepage hero image: the white Tudor-revival house seen across the lawn through trees, framed by clipped hedges. Wikimedia Commons only holds an 1880 historic engraving of the house, not a photograph, so the hotel's own site was used.

domaine-des-etangs.licence: hotel group's own website imagery, rights not cleared for republication
domaine-des-etangs.source: https://fr.auberge.com/domaine-des-etangs/ (og:image; page itself blocks direct automated fetch, image CDN does not)
domaine-des-etangs.note: Aerial of the turreted château on its island within the estate's lakes, pool and tennis court visible; no people. No Wikimedia Commons coverage found for this property.

estelle-manor.note: The building is Eynsham Hall, the Grade II mansion now trading as Estelle Manor (rebranded/reopened May 2023); photo predates the rebrand but shows the unchanged exterior/grounds.

gleneagles.note: Front facade of the hotel with its formal fountain and gardens, taken from the south-east.

heckfield-place.licence: hotel website imagery, rights not cleared for republication
heckfield-place.note: The Georgian house seen across the lake at dawn with full reflection; no people. The Wikimedia Commons image ('Heckfield Place Gardens and Lake', geograph 816122) was superseded by this clearer, higher-resolution hotel-sourced shot after Wikimedia's servers repeatedly rate-limited downloads; this one shows the house itself more clearly.

hotel-du-cap-eden-roc.note: Main facade of the hotel viewed up the entrance drive through umbrella pines. Clean CC licence.

hotel-pitrizza.credit: Hotel Pitrizza, a Luxury Collection Hotel (photo: Olivier Fly, 2023)
hotel-pitrizza.licence: hotel's own press/gallery imagery, rights not cleared for republication
hotel-pitrizza.note: Aerial view of Pitrizza's rock-set individual villas and pools on the Liscia di Vacca coastline, Costa Smeralda -- verified this is Pitrizza specifically (from Hotel Pitrizza's own site, filename says 'HotelPitrizza-Landscape'), not a neighbouring Costa Smeralda property such as Cala di Volpe or Romazzino.

il-pellicano.licence: hotel website imagery, rights not cleared for republication
il-pellicano.note: The hotel's terracotta cliffside buildings and gardens above the pool terrace; a few distant figures are incidental (dining under awnings), not portraits, and the building is unmistakably the subject. No Wikimedia Commons coverage found. The site's homepage og:image (a 1970s-style poolside photo with sunbathers prominent) was rejected as too people-centric.

il-san-pietro-di-positano.credit: Il San Pietro di Positano (hotel's own website gallery)
il-san-pietro-di-positano.note: Aerial view of the terraced hotel built into the cliff face above the sea, with the Amalfi coastline behind. No usable image found on Wikimedia Commons — the only Commons file returned by search under the hotel's name was unrelated (a mythological carving on Positano's cathedral bell tower).

la-bastide-de-gordes.credit: HiddenCliff, 2024, courtesy Airelles (hotel group's own press/website imagery)
la-bastide-de-gordes.licence: hotel website, rights not cleared for republication
la-bastide-de-gordes.note: Drone view of the hotel building, terraces, pool and gardens against the village of Gordes; the page's own og:image, filename credits '©HiddenCliff-2024'.

la-reserve-ramatuelle.licence: hotel's own press/website imagery, rights not cleared for republication
la-reserve-ramatuelle.note: The hotel's distinctive curved-canopy entrance building framing a sea view; filename is explicitly 'property_exterior_entrance'. Note: the site's own gallery page also serves an image literally named 'the-hotel.jpg' that is actually a Paris rooftop/Grand Palais view (a mismatched asset on their WordPress media library) -- that file was identified and rejected as wrong-property.

le-grand-controle.note: This is the Hôtel du Grand Contrôle building itself (not the main Château de Versailles palace), photographed from the Orangerie parterre garden it overlooks, per the brief. Photo dates from 2015, before the 2016-2021 Airelles restoration, so some weathering/patched render is visible on the facade; it is the correct and only building, just not post-renovation. A closer 2007 Commons photo of the same building (street-facade, run-down, parked car) was rejected in favour of this cleaner garden view.

le-sirenuse.licence: hotel website, rights not cleared for republication
le-sirenuse.note: The hotel's own pool terrace and part of its red facade in the foreground against the Positano coastline; no photographer credited on the page. Two straight-on facade/drone shots on the same domain were tried first but were either portrait-only or too generic a town panorama to read unmistakably as the hotel without a caption; this framing keeps the hotel's own terrace and building fabric identifiable.

passalacqua.note: Wide landscape view of the villa (built for Count Andrea Lucini Passalacqua, the building the 2023-opened hotel occupies) and its terraced gardens above Lake Como, framed from Via Giuseppe Bianchi in Proo.

rosewood-schloss-fuschl.note: Aerial view of the castle on its wooded peninsula on Lake Fuschl. Clean public-domain licence.

royal-champagne.credit: Royal Champagne Hotel & Spa (hotel's own website gallery)
royal-champagne.note: Exterior of the modernist wing at sunset, terrace and vineyard hillside in view. No usable image found on Wikimedia Commons.

son-bunyola.credit: Virgin Limited Edition (hotel group's own website imagery)
son-bunyola.licence: hotel website, rights not cleared for republication
son-bunyola.note: The restored finca building, terrace and pool against the Tramuntana mountains; the site's own homepage hero image, no photographer credited.

villa-d-este.note: Aerial view of the lakeside hotel building and floating pool on Lake Como; no people prominent. Source image is 1200x675 so used at native width.

villa-la-coste.credit: Villa La Coste (hotel's own website imagery)
villa-la-coste.licence: hotel website, rights not cleared for republication
villa-la-coste.note: Hotel pool with the villa's stone-and-glass building visible above the cypress row behind. The site's own homepage hero (og:image, an unpeopled vineyard-view crop from the same October 2023 shoot) was tried first but shows no building at all, so this frame was used instead as the only landscape shot in the set that keeps the building legible. No Villa La Coste-specific Wikimedia Commons images exist; the Commons category for the wider Château La Coste estate holds only winery/art-pavilion shots, not the hotel.
